scope.ui_transport: isolated real Vue/ElementPlus/Vuex/request with canonical rspack Babel rule and browser mocked HTTP using original actual Main/JWT bytes
not_claimed: No live backend/MySQL from the browser suites.
No production build or global 76 browser/full backend acceptance in this frontend-only phase.
No scientific/clinical variable validity, missingness diagnosis, anonymity, automatic export, matrix construction or model call.
No browser HMAC recomputation: the private key remains in SQL.
No all-clinical-source completeness claim from a metadata page.

interfaces.source_only_projection: verifyResearchVariableBatchProjection({snapshot,proof},source,{expectedBatchId,current,validateCurrentRecipe}) -> Promise<boolean>; consistency only, no authority grant. Strict published2 Task wrapper remains unchanged.
interfaces.read: readVerifiedResearchVariableBatch(id,{current}) -> metadata then source/snapshot complete parts then exact final metadata; bundle {metadata,currentValidation,source,snapshot:{snapshot,proof}}. Dictionary analogous definition/scope.

input.selection: Initial reference is pending, requires explicit fresh read. No auto-first. Explicit known Batch UUID can also be entered and fully reread. Closed/deactivated/identity/role/token/username/props change and unmount clear availability; no automatic restoration.

permissions_and_limits.project_directory_limitation: The existing74 Scope directory/current read API allows only super_admin/admin/director/doctor. Source UI disables that directory for pharmacist and describes the restriction. Authorized pharmacist may use an explicit existing Batch reference through76 full-part routes, independently enforced by server; this phase does not extend74 access or claim a real Pharmacist Main lifecycle positive.
permissions_and_limits.technical_directory: Super-only bodyless Source metadata; zero clinical parts, no execution/write/source selection from metadata. No frozen clinical bypass after purpose withdrawal.
permissions_and_limits.current_server_authority: Explicit project/Scope3anchors, all Scope patients and research_variable_extraction purpose; model transfer separately checked by Task flow. Super has no purpose/patient bypass.
permissions_and_limits.governance: Typed variable form, whole preview, original content/hash CAS and original-basis transition checks; independent definition review remains separate from technical publication. Server enforces current author/reviewer and actual AuditPK; browser structural proof cannot establish SQL audit existence.
permissions_and_limits.raw_literals: NULL/empty/string/int32/date/naive clock preserved and full hashes verified. BOM/CRLF/emoji exact request and literal test; displayed field pagination does not truncate proof.
permissions_and_limits.budgets: Each complete Source part/wire is capped at8MiB before decode; no claim all private/public pieces fit one8MiB combination. Metadata/ACK are not full proof.
permissions_and_limits.no_source_mutation: No backend, four maps, Source12/10recipe, catalog/runtime/main, shared Parent/History/TaskFlow/Assistant/Findings or prior specs changed.

actual_main_packet.scope: Single new Source-only synthetic Main/JWT lifecycle. Scope/ACL/patient authorization seeded by real services, all business requests actual Main. Existing seven-state Task packet is separate, not stitched.

fixture_provenance.dom_derived_transport: Intermediate draft-phase directory wrappers are explicitly derived from actual bodyless metadata; full parts and ACKs remain original actual responses. Negative mutations are test-only and marked by spec; no success flags/hashes fabricated.
